to: A contract that cannot fail closes a task as green as one that can

The coverage signal, not the negative control. A negative control re-runs the whole contract on a reverted tree: it doubles the cost of every closing in an unattended loop, and it cannot be built at all where the change is not revertible in isolation. The coverage signal is read from a run that happens anyway, so a closing costs what it costs today.
